item.title: GuocoLand books $85.4 mil earnings for 1HFY2026, up 14% y-o-y
item.description: GuocoLand recorded a 14% y-o-y increase in profit attributable to equity holders to $85.4 million for the first half ended Dec 31, 2025 (1HFY2026), despite a decline in revenue across the same period. Group revenue declined 22% y-o-y in 1HFY2026 to $791.9 million, due largely to the timing of progressive revenue recognition from residential projects under construction. item.title: Former JTC chief Tan Boon Khai to lead Therme Group’s $1 bil Marina South wellness resort project
item.description: Therme Group has appointed former JTC Corp chief Tan Boon Khai as CEO of Therme Group Singapore. In a Feb 2 press release, the developer says Tan will lead the development of Therme Singapore, its $1 billion wellness attraction at Marina South. Tan was CEO of JTC Corp between September 2020 and March 2025. Prior to that, he served as chief executive of the Singapore Land Authority and held senior roles at CapitaLand and The Ascott. item.title: Coliwoo buys hotel strata lot at ESR BizPark @ Changi for $101 mil
item.description: Coliwoo has secured an option to buy a hotel strata lot in Changi from ESR-REIT. According to filings with the Singapore Exchange, a Coliwoo subsidiary has entered into a put and call option agreement with an ESR-REIT sub-trust to purchase the leasehold estate with respect to a hotel strata lot at 2 Changi Business Park Avenue 1. item.title: HDB to launch three BTO projects at Lakeview and Shunfu from June
item.description: For the first time in over four decades, new public housing will be introduced in Lakeview and Shunfu. In a Feb 2 press release, HDB says three Build-To-Order (BTO) projects will be launched in the areas – two in Lakeview, and one in Shunfu. The projects will deliver about 1,600 new homes when completed. The first project to be launched is located at Lakeview and comprises about 1,200 units. item.title: Japan's property market demands a new adaptive playbook for investors
item.description: Investors may need to recalibrate their approach to Japanese real estate as inflation returns after decades of falling prices. Strategies focused on occupancy and stability — once effective during the deflation era — should give way to approaches that emphasise rent growth and active asset management. item.title: Dubai’s housing market sets new records in 2025 as prime homes lead growth
item.description: Dubai’s residential market closed 2025 on a strong note, with both transaction volumes and values reaching new highs, even as signs of market maturity begin to emerge, according to the latest Dubai Residential Market Review Q42025 by Knight Frank. A total of 205,400 residential transactions were recorded in Dubai in 2025, marking an 18% increase from the previous year.
